name: 78213 · San Antonio, TX
findings: ZIP 78213 (San Antonio) has 137 nonprofit organizations. 53 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 47 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (39% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78213 (San Antonio) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 78213 (San Antonio) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
